notes.title: Steam Leaderboards and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Steam Leaderboards. [/h1][/b]

I have added Steam Leaderboards to the game so now you show off your times/Wins to the reset of the world.
Which means all your local scores are gone, Sorry! 

Times / Wins board now has 3 buttons Global / Friends / Your Position. Only for the currently selected level.

[h3]Lobby mini games[/h3]

Added another shooter mini game. (All scores are also Global only shows the top 10.)

Added both mini Shooters to the singleplayer lobby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/9d7d209bf0bacb882523f14cbaf6a60427273b2f.png[/img]


[b][h2]New Player Characters[/h2][/b]

Added lots of new player Characters to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/b54a0acd7268cfa5779e16de22686698eaab3059.png[/img]

[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] SteamVR Will no longer start up if you are not playing in VR.

[*] Valve grip's have been adjusted so they dont drop Items Randomly (Untested at this moment. I dont own a Vive).

[*] Grip Distance for non-VR Players has been increased.

[*]

[/list]

notes.title: 0.0.3.21 Non-VR Update, Tanks, Spaceships and Much More.
notes.notes:
Here is a [b]Massive[/b] update for version [b]0.0.3.21[/b]

The game has had a massive overhaul with a new player system, Animations, Sounds and Effects. 

First lets start with the fixes.

[h2]FIXES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Lighting on some of the levels.
[*] AI going though the islands on Spainish invasion.
[*] Extras cannons no longer fire if you dont have them.
[*] Laser grid start time.
[*] Player scores are stored for a short time if you lose connection or quit.
[*] No more flying everywhere when you get hit due to a new hit system.
[*] Added a glowing orb above player ships in Space invasion (Wave mode)
[*] Much more I'd be here all day listing them. ːsteamhappyː
[/list]

[b]Gardor[/b] - The great Icewall has been redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/0b81837b2fe1154aaedbd8e460b34031d91f460c.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/a09f469f57c83e25724d2c0489793b0bf6cbe1af.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/415103e1f18f3d325202c48a8d09242f2f103c4b.png[/img][/url]

Ok now for the good stuff.

[h1][b]NEW[/b][/h1]

[h2]NON-VR[/h2]

You can now play with Non-VR players, they do have limits. [b]ie[/b] - Can only carry 1 weapon, also cant throw the swords or shields. Climbing can be difficult (but all part of the fun).

Every Gamemode is playable in Non-VR using either a controller or keyboard and mouse. (No keybinding yet but will be added in the future.)

Non-VR player hud.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/c711d11ff632a6043a15d1097635cdb5bf12da88.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/b3b10f91b84e7f55afc02fa01981ef1cbe3ba4ff.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/5290a4634124ab5bbc1af4ac7d8351f056568c7c.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/0f6c772ab90e43230b4563528b445c2a8b5f9fcc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/f80ed9bf513ddd1a95dcc6dc0db86c9ac0761468.png[/img][/url]


[h2]PLAYER MODELS[/h2]

[b]New player models[/b] have been added to make customizing your character easier. (Will more than likely be changed again, as those are assets from the store and everyone seems to use them.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/f3858b4dc54f8de09791b4a9030edfdaf4d86127.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/fd2820b13b7aa09187811b1a2003642ef35f28d4.png[/img]

[b]Player Animations[/b] well makes sense now that you have legs and arms. (Still need's work in places.)

[b]New player hands[/b] (just 100X better than the old ones.) (No gestures other than pointing but more will be added.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/0deee57f2bb85596e07b380bb2b099f694c0bb84.png[/img]


[h2]MAIN MENU AND LOBBIES[/h2]

Lobbies and Main Screen has been redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/1a51c8779f987b60231accf333c0ee4fb2faf747.png[/img]

Done a whole redesign of the main menu which has the character shop, level shop and customizing the player. Yes you can customise your character in the lobbies aswell.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/da8c0e89a535228e7ac5f6875f6471c87ab4a2f2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/8d8381ba6de7b6e3faa7c71adf78ce49b7980807.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/e8b7492dd993a359333a2d4fa206d50ac7e8101a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/dfad8b6d925a113634e47122c3b9ddea4a70bd38.png[/img][/url]

Added a quick join button so you can get straight to the action. Or if no games are found will create a Quick match lobby where voting is key.

Added a Mini-game to the lobbies while you wait for other players or beat the Hosts score. Even a piano so the VR players can play you some songs while you wait.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/ccf22183e04b8278cdfc9813ecc9552a828e7d5a.png[/img]

[h1]CHALLENGES[/h1]

Challenges have been added to the main menu with challenges that last a day, a week or a month. All with Rewards once completed. (More will be added. ideas?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/b6fdc99574f1a9ea47719ed7dd0b8a55f7beb10c.png[/img]

[h3][b]GAMEMODES[/b][/h3]

[b]Tanks[/b] - Fight in armoured combat on the new large scale map Farmland. Found in battleships gamemode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/7455822694b6feb7f0795e63cf85daf784eb3723.png[/img]

[b]Spaceships[/b] - Fly around the new map Asteroids while trying to destroy the other players. Also found in battleships gamemode. (Very fast movment).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40466570/3070538e9f5d065567cbd48ef2d29e94e52eadf9.png[/img]

[b]Rumble / Rumble Squads[/b] - Players now drop items on death. (Health / Ammo  refill  etc) (maybe even weapons??)

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]0.0.315[/b] Bug Fixes ([b]Hot Fixes[/b])

Few bug people have noticed I have fixed,

[list]
[*]The Player no longer sees their own spawn protection.
[*]Climbing on Treasure Island.
[*]Cave is lighter on Monkey Business.
[*]Removed invisible wall that stopped you from getting to the Monkey bars. (Monkey Business)
[*]Added a pipe barrier to split the different sections. (Monkey Business)
[*]Removed Punch from the Lobby.
[*]Fixed Money / level and best times Reset.
[*]You no longer will get stuck in the corner on breach.
[*]Fix a load screen Glitch.
[/list]
